section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a single study (Study X) conducted in the US using an online survey method via Prolific Academic and Qualtrics. The final sample consisted of 315 participants (151 women and 164 men) with a mean age of 32.55 years, predominantly White (88.9%), and 68.2% with college or higher education. BMI was self-reported with a mean of 25.85 kg/m².
